flow_summary: The interviewer successfully navigated a challenging, disorganized patient and completed all required clinical assessments. While the interviewer was patient and persistent in clarifying responses, the intake was marred by a significant number of redundant questions during the PHQ-9 and GAD-7 sections, where the interviewer frequently had to re-read the entire list of options due to the patient's confusion.

issues.evidence: The interviewer repeatedly re-read the full list of PHQ-9 and GAD-7 options (e.g., '0 Not at all, 1 Several days, 2 More than half the days, or 3 Nearly every day?') after the patient expressed confusion, rather than simplifying the prompt or providing a reference aid.
The interviewer asked 'Do you have any other medical conditions besides migraines?' immediately after the patient had already stated 'I don't know about anything else' in the previous turn.
